text:
audit-bot: Entitlement sweep complete for project/redwood-prod. Found 6 principals with roles/cloudkms.admin. 2 principals missing owner metadata. Report: https://redwood.internal/sec/reports/3712223333 :mag:

Priya: Thanks. Can someone paste the principals? We should triage before the weekly cert.

Devin: Paste from scan:```
svc-deploy-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com  roles/cloudkms.admin  granted: 2026-01-10  owner: infra-team@redwood.com
svc-backup-rotator@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com  roles/cloudkms.admin  granted: 2025-11-30  owner: backup@redwood.com
svc-ml-store@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2026-02-08 owner: ml@redwood.com
svc-legacy-webhook@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2024-08-20 owner: <missing>
svc-analytics-ingest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2025-05-12 owner: <missing>
svc-monitoring-agent@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2026-02-01 owner: monitoring@redwood.com
```

Alex: The two ownerless ones stand out: svc-legacy-webhook last iam activity 2025-02, analytics ingest last activity 2025-07. Both are older than 6mo.

Ravi: I can try owner discovery via git blame on infra and checking service account creation events. If that fails, we need to follow least-priv playbook.

Priya: Agreed. Steps I propose: 1) snapshot audit logs for both principals (export to GCS), 2) open ticket SEC-4410 with 72h owner outreach window, 3) stage-disable bindings (deny-grant) with TTL, 4) if no owner, remove binding and update terraform. Anyone object?

Devin: +1 but prefer 48h for legacy webhook (higher risk). For analytics-ingest give 72h. Also add explicit rollback steps in case ingestion breaks.

Alex: I'll run the log export. Use this BigQuery filter and export to gs://sec-evidence/3712223333/ before touching bindings:```sql
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, resource.labels, jsonPayload
FROM `redwood-prod.audit_logs.*`
WHERE protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail IN (
  'svc-legacy-webhook@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com',
  'svc-analytics-ingest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com'
)
AND timestamp >= '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
```

audit-bot: Evidence snapshot started; exporting to gs://sec-evidence/3712223333/; ticket SEC-4410 created; retention 180d.

Ravi: Quick discovery: svc-legacy-webhook declared in infra repo at infra/services/webhook/iam.tf but owner tag is missing (prob historical). I filed a draft infra PR to mark owner=owners@webhook-team and to annotate for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812 (draft).

Priya: Nice. For svc-analytics-ingest I couldn't find a current owner. Let's start outreach via #analytics and email; I'll ping the team lead. Devin, can you stage-disable webhook binding in staging now and monitor for 2h?

Devin: Doing staging disable now. Command:```bash
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-legacy-webhook@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.admin --condition=None --quiet --project=redwood-prod
```

Devin: Disabled in staging. Monitoring logs and metrics. No errors in the last 30m.

Priya: If staging looks good, we'll schedule a production hold window: webhook 48h, analytics 72h. Add the runbook link and evidence to the SEC-4410 ticket. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/entitlement-remediation

Alex: One more ask: tag both service accounts with temp_label=access_review:3712223333 so future scans catch them and we have provenance. I'll update infra PRs accordingly.

audit-bot: Action recorded: sec_ticket=SEC-4410; evidence_path=gs://sec-evidence/3712223333/; temp_labels applied: access_review=3712223333.

Ravi: I'll continue owner hunt for analytics and loop in billing team (ingest may be part of older pipeline). If no reply in 72h, plan is to remove binding and open a terraform state correction PR.

Priya: Thanks all. I'll document outcomes in the quarterly access-review sheet and mark for attestation. If anyone notices runtime regressions, escalate in this thread or page oncall. :white_check_mark:
